title: What if an AI API had to return a type instead of vibes?
hook: What if an AI API returned a type instead of a paragraph? We ran the live call.
thesis: PING uses Jev as a shadow sensor for fast typed classification and routing decisions. The live contract: POST /v1/systemone takes a model, a state object, and keyed questions, and returns typed answers. The smoke test question scored noul: 0.97. This post shows the actual call, then the point: gate an action on a number, not a paragraph.

verified: POST /v1/systemone takes model (e.g. jev-latest), state object, and keyed questions each with type and instructions; returns HTTP 200 with typed answers under answers (live 2026-09-30, ts-smoke.py, via SYSTEMS.md section 6).
The noul question type returns a numeric 0-1 score: a live smoke question returned {"noul": 0.97, "confidence": null} (live 2026-09-30, via SYSTEMS.md section 6).
unknown: Cost per call, latency guarantees, rate limits, and what attestation cryptographically proves (SYSTEMS.md section 6).

approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
